texts.preamble: Babulal Ram vs The State Of Jharkhand. ..... Opposite ... on 18 October, 2022 Author: Deepak Roshan Bench: Deepak Roshan 1 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi Cr. Revision No. 121 of 2007 --------- 1.Babulal Ram. 2.Ashok Ram. ..... Petitioners Versus The State of Jharkhand. ..... Opposite Party --------- Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Deepak Roshan --------- For the Petitioner : Mr. Birat Kumar, Adv.
texts.facts: A service report has been received indicating therein that petitioner no. 1, namely- Babulal Ram has died and the notice has been served upon the petitioner no.2. 3. In view of the aforesaid fact, the instant application is dismissed as abated against the petitioner no. 1, namely- Babulal Ram.
texts.arguments: 5. Learned counsel for the petitioner fairly confines his argument on the question of sentence on the ground that the instant case is of the year 1991 and about 31 years have elapsed since then and the petitioner must have suffered the mental agony for ongoing litigation. He further submits that the petitioner no.2 remained in custody for about 18 days and has never misused the privilege of bail and he is not a habitual offender and is the only earing member of his family, as such some leniency may be granted by this Court and sentence may be modified to period already undergone. 6. Learned Addl.P.P. opposes the contention of the petitioner and submits that there is concurrent finding and as such, no interference is required. 7.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 5.
